_comment: Applied to the shared ammaridev-uc1gfp bucket (local dev + deployed dev share one bucket, split by the local/ vs dev/ key prefix). Public GetObject is scoped to exactly the prefixes apps/web's storefront renders publicly (products/* — product images; content/* — homepage hero/feature block images) plus local/healthcheck/* (packages/storage's storage:check script, local-only — never run against the deployed dev env, so no dev/healthcheck/* entry). Everything else in the bucket stays private by default (no matching statement). Apply/verify with `pnpm --filter @ammari/storage policy:apply -- --env dev` (see that script and docs/deploy.md). This _comment key is stripped by the apply script before calling PutBucketPolicy — real S3-compatible APIs reject unknown top-level policy keys.
